CV Builder

CV Builder helps users creating and customizing their CVs by filling out information and choosing their favorite design. The app is written in Ruby on Rails. Some of the features are: auto-saving, HTML/PDF generation, OAuth, ...

Mark Zero Framework

Markzero is a web framework that helps developer build web apps fast and properly. The project is inspired by the big and matured frameworks like Symfony and Ruby on Rails. Some of it's features are: Routing (URI-matching mechanism is extensible), free choice of project structure, response to multiple MIME-type, Validation, pluggable view rendering engine...

ABC Music Player

ABC Music Player is a Java programm that reads and parses files written in ABC-Notation and plays the notes accordingly. This project can handle a subset of ABC-Notation.

Longpolling App

Implement simple long-polling mechanism (inspired by facebook notification system) that simulate server-push. Users will receive "notification" when an event happens without having to reload the browser.
